events.description: Flash survey of UK services-sector activity; an early read on growth momentum for the BoE.

events.description: Conference Board gauge of US household sentiment; signals consumer spending appetite heading into the holidays.

events.description: Survey of German business sentiment; a leading indicator for Europe's largest economy and Eurozone growth.
